topic: How does defocused reflector gain loss impact link budget margins for SNR compared to conventional designs?
consensus_response: Defocused reflector gain loss reduces SNR margins due to broadened patterns, introducing 1.52-1.70 dB loss, but mitigates feed element failures. This trade-off affects link budget margins, system capacity, and performance. Adaptive beamforming optimizes SNR margins, preserving system reliability and capacity.
reference_context: Defocused reflectors reduce gain loss, but increase interference, affecting system capacity and SNR margins.
